meta.name: pr-captain-post-merge
meta.description: Captain-only. After a PR has merged on GitHub, verify the merge, merge origin/master locally, sync all worktrees, create the GitHub release (every PR is a release), and clean up the PR branch. Formerly `/post-merge` — v2 rename to noun-actor-verb.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: PR 合并后自动验证、发布并清理分支。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是维护 GitHub 仓库的管理员，需要自动化发布流程。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify, release, and clean up after PR merge.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage GitHub repositories and need automated post-merge release workflow.

howto.what: 安装后，当 GitHub 上的 PR 合并后，Claude 会验证合并、本地合并 origin/master、同步所有工作树、创建 GitHub 发布（每个 PR 对应一个发布），然后清理 PR 分支。
howto.when: 仅在 master 分支的主检出（非工作树）中，且 GitHub 上 PR 刚合并时触发。用户说“merged”或“done”等表示 PR 已合并，或作为 /pr-captain-land 的第 8 步调用。从不自动触发。

say.note: 对 PR #123 执行合后流程。
查询最近合并的 PR 并确认后执行。

howto.what_en: After a PR merges on GitHub, Claude verifies the merge, merges origin/master locally, syncs all worktrees, creates a GitHub release (every PR is a release), and cleans up the PR branch.
howto.when_en: Triggered only from master in main checkout (not worktree) immediately after a PR merges on GitHub. Triggered when user says "merged", "done", or as Step 8 of /pr-captain-land. Never auto-invoked.

say_en.note: Runs the post-merge flow for PR #123.
Queries the most recently merged PR and proceeds after confirmation.
